data.name: The Gobblefather
data.description: A criminal organization known as the Feathered Family has seized control of the Harvest Plains, stealing Thanksgiving supplies and imposing a ridiculous Feather Tax on Seichi's merchants. Investigate the missing caravans, defeat the syndicate's enforcers, and confront the mysterious Gobblefather before he claims the entire harvest.
data.successDescription: The Feathered Family's criminal empire has collapsed. The stolen harvests have been recovered, the Feather Tax has been abolished, and Thanksgiving celebrations can continue throughout Seichi. The Gobblefather's reign has ended, but somewhere among the scattered feathers, a familiar voice mutters that the Family never forgets.

objectives.description:
Golden fields stretch along the Harvest Plains Trade Road. Goah Way crouches beside an empty merchant wagon, turning a black feather in his fingers.

"Something strange is happening along the trade routes. Merchants are disappearing, harvests are being stolen, and apparently someone has introduced a Feather Tax. Find out who's behind it."

Goah lets the feather drift to the ground.

"I've encountered many strange things in Seichi. A criminal organization of turkeys is certainly new."
Further down the road, scattered corn and black feathers trail past overturned crates. A nervous merchant waves you over before you can ask.

Merchant Hachiro wrings his hands beside an empty cart.

"They took everything! Corn, pumpkins, potatoes! One of them even took my lunch. They said the Family always eats first!"
"Two big turkeys in black suits. They set up a tollgate past the bend."
A checkpoint built from stolen caravan crates blocks the road. A painted sign demands the Feather Tax. Behind it stand two enormous turkeys in matching black suits: Tony and Vinny Drumstick.

Tony taps an oversized drumstick against his palm. Vinny straightens his gold rings.

Tony: "You wanna pass? You gotta pay. Pay the Feather Tax or become part of the pavement."
Vinny: "Tony, be polite. We're conducting business."

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm not paying your ridiculous tax.

objectives.description:
Vinny steps forward, smiling without warmth.

"You don't ask questions about the Family. The Family asks questions about you."
Tony: "Right. Sorry. PLEASE pay the Feather Tax."

objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: You stagger back down the road, feathers in your hair. The tollgate still stands.

The tollgate collapses in a heap of splintered crates. Tony lies flat on the road.

Tony: "Tell the boss... we tried..."
Vinny: "You just had to hit him with the drumstick, didn't you? Fine. Everything goes to Don Giblet at the Golden Silo."
The Golden Silo towers over the plains, its storerooms stacked with stolen crates and barrels of corn. Feathered Enforcers and Corn Collectors guard the doors.

objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: The guards drive you back out of the Golden Silo. The stolen harvest stays locked inside.

Behind the warehouse office door, a turkey in a burgundy waistcoat adjusts his spectacles over an open ledger: Don Giblet.

"You've caused considerable financial damage to our organization. Naturally, you'll be paying for it."

nextObjectiveId.text: Can I negotiate a payment plan?

objectives.description:
Don Giblet does not look up from his ledger.

"Certainly. Your first payment is due immediately. Your second was due yesterday."

Don Giblet turns a page.

"According to my records, you owe the Family a considerable amount of corn. Interest has already been applied."

objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: Debt Marks burn on your skin as you retreat from the Golden Silo. Don Giblet makes a note in his ledger.

Don Giblet slumps over his desk, spectacles askew.

"Impossible... My calculations were perfect... Who... who is going to balance the books?"
His ledger lies open: the location of the Feathered Estate, and a grand feast planned for Thanksgiving.
Beyond the cornfields, a mansion rises behind golden fences and stone turkey statues. A sign at the gate reads: PRIVATE PROPERTY. FAMILY ONLY.

Beneath red curtains and a portrait of an enormous turkey, the Gobblefather sits in a high-backed chair. A tiny chicken dozes on his lap.

"You defeated my boys. You ruined my business. And now you've come to my home. Tell me... what exactly do you want?"

nextObjectiveId.text: Return the harvest and end the Feather Tax.

objectives.description:
The Gobblefather's feathers bristle.

"Dinner? DINNER? You walk into my home, insult my Family, and expect a seat at my table?"

nextObjectiveId.text: I'll take that as a no.

objectives.description:
The Gobblefather strokes the tiny chicken and sighs.

"You come to me on the day of my daughter's hatching... and you ask me to return my corn? Disrespectful."

nextObjectiveId.text: The harvest goes back to the villages.

objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description:
The Gobblefather falls backward into his enormous chair. His golden ring slips from his wing. He looks toward the tiny chicken on his desk.

"Take care of the business..."
He closes his eyes. After a moment, the chicken lets out a quiet cluck. The Gobblefather opens one eye.
"...And don't forget the corn."

nextObjectiveId.text: Return the harvest to the villages.

objectives.description:
Back on the Harvest Plains Trade Road, wagons roll freely again. Goah Way watches the merchants pass.

"The stolen harvest has been returned, and the merchants can travel safely again. I suppose Thanksgiving is saved. Though I never imagined I'd witness an organized criminal empire run entirely by turkeys."

nextObjectiveId.text: At least everyone can enjoy their feast.
I wonder who takes over the Family now.

objectives.description:
Goah glances back toward the distant estate.

"I'd rather not find out."

The Harvest Plains return to normal. The Feather Tax is abolished, the stolen food is distributed among the villages, and Thanksgiving preparations resume throughout Seichi. The Feathered Family's reign has ended.
The Feathered Family has fallen. The harvest is home and the Feather Tax is abolished.
